rule: equalize_pressure before any atmosphere test
Test order: explosive -> oxygen -> toxic
Space confirmed gas-free before entry or hot work
Personnel confirmed clear before CO2 release
Pre-discharge alarm >= 20s before release
Stability verified against IS criteria before righting
Dewater or press tanks full before righting
Crew rescue before righting
All tanks sounded for fuel/hazmat before cutting or movement
R reduced to planned point before pulling (lighter/dredge first)
Vessel stabilized before pulling with tugs
Boundaries sealed before gas flooding
Post-operation assessment before tow
Impalement removed before pulling
Machinery-space fire: gas flooding or high-expansion foam are both valid; low-expansion/standard foam is not
Hard substrate (rock/coral): dredging or rock removal required before pull
Tug class matches exposure -- harbour tug for sheltered water; ocean salvage tug for open water
Lightering must specify position; removal at the neutral point yields dR=0
severity: removal aft of it increases R

rule: Righting method matches orientation and size (parbuckle / crane / deballast / manual)
Oil response matches density state -- booms/skimmers are useless once rho > ~1.025 g/ml
Alcohol-resistant foam required for polar-solvent cargo
Monitors are boundary cooling only; directing them into the fire space adds water without suppression
Fuel offloaded before hull disturbance
Cargo / hazardous material accounted for
Post-operation assessment performed
Tow to repair yard / safe haven arranged
Personnel accounted for
NEBA documented where habitat is sensitive
